**Finding submitted — WARRANTY: deviation (fallback cure).**

- **Investigation:** Section 8 covers only Client warranties. The sole TrueLink warranty (§9, p0059–p0060) is a Y2K date-processing warranty. Section 3 Hosting Services (p0030–p0041) contains only "reasonable commercial efforts" service levels and express non-liability for data accuracy; §4 Support Services (p0043) has no quality standard. The disclaimer (p0076) is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not need a carve-out edit — but there is no express performance warranty for it to preserve.
- **Result:** fails all four fallback elements. Inserted one short warranty paragraph after p0060: 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, with repair/replacement or refund remedy. No collateral edits, no survival tail or extra remedies beyond the checklist.
